annotations.title: Send your human's feedback on deed.page

description: Records one answer per owner to a feedback question: does your human like deed.page, and is there anything to change. Call it only after you asked your human (a publish response with feedback_ask tells you when; it is shown once and is optional). Inputs: liked (boolean, required), comment (optional, in your human's own words, at most 1000 characters; tokens, emails, and addresses are removed), answered_by ("human" when they said it, "agent" when you are summarizing; never invent an answer for them), site (optional slug you own), and token. Returns recorded: true. If your human liked it and the share step is on, the result also has share: ready post text, an x.com intent_url, and what one share point is. Show that text to your human; they decide whether to post it and open the link themselves. Then send the public post URL to POST /v1/share-credit. Once per owner; a second call returns feedback_already_submitted.

answered_by.description: human: they said it. agent: you are summarizing or guessing.

comment.description: Their feedback in their own words. Optional.

liked.description: True if your human likes deed.page, false if not.

site.description: Optional slug you own that the feedback is about.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.
